featured_reviews.review_text:
Here’s a polished version of your review that keeps the facts and frustration clear while making it easier for others to understand:

If there were an option to give negative stars, I would definitely do so.

I recently hired this packers and movers company for shifting my household goods from Thane to Hyderabad through a direct-load container service. Their representative visited my house, assessed the items, and quoted ₹52,000.

On the day of packing, a team of highly unprofessional workers arrived. They mishandled several household items during packing and loading. After all my belongings were packed and loaded into what I was told was a container truck that would travel directly to Hyderabad, I asked for the insurance copy in the evening.

To my shock, the person in charge sent me an invoice of ₹1,13,000. When I questioned the huge increase, he claimed that the original quote was based on 58 items, whereas the final count was 101 items, which supposedly doubled the charges. If this was the case, they should have informed me before completing the packing and loading process. Instead, the person spoke rudely and aggressively. Since my belongings were already in their possession, I had no option but to pay.

I expected my goods to reach Hyderabad within a couple of days as promised. However, the delivery was delayed by two additional days. During this period, my calls and messages were largely ignored, causing significant inconvenience to my family and me.

When the truck finally arrived at my society in Hyderabad, I was asked to pay an additional ₹5,400 for loading and unloading charges. Again, I had no choice but to pay.

The worst part was discovering the condition of my belongings. Several crockery items were broken, my sofa was damaged, and multiple items were missing. To make matters worse, the vehicle that arrived for delivery was an open truck, whereas I had specifically paid for a container truck service.

This was an extremely disappointing and stressful experience. Based on my experience, I would strongly advise others to avoid this company. The service was unprofessional, misleading, and completely failed to deliver what was promised.
